text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali and First Lady Leila on Wednesday chaired a ceremony in Carthage Palace at the occasion of Women's Day.
- Monastir airport registered the arrival of 1.6 million passengers during the first seven months of 1997, up by 18.5 percent compared to the same period last year.
- Work started to build a marina at Houmt Essouk in the island of Djerba. The project is worth 80 million dinars ($70 million).
